An invitation for BNY

Two days of what's next in workplace design, on Franklin.

See what's coming in workplace design without spending a month on showroom visits. MiniCon brings over 80 brands to Bakery Square for two days, and the people behind them are there to talk through applications and answer your questions. Both days we're hosting thought leader discussions on AI: how leading organizations are factoring it into their facilities, hiring, and growth strategies, plus an AI expert on how it can improve design workflows.

See the schedule Travel and hotel

Franklin is covering flights and hotel accommodations for BNY guests coming from out of town. Rooms are held at the SpringHill Suites directly across from the show. Tell us which nights you need and we will book it, or email Ashley Carney with your travel details.

What Is MiniCon

Franklin's two-day product showcase, our local take on NeoCon.

MiniCon is the largest commercial design showcase in Western Pennsylvania. Over 80 brands across furniture, flooring, interior construction, and specialty solutions set up at Bakery Square, with product experts from each manufacturer on the floor to answer questions and talk through specifics.

Designers, architects, corporate real estate teams, facilities leaders, and educators all move through the floor over the two days. For BNY, it is a fast way to see what is available, compare options side by side, and get answers without scheduling a dozen separate meetings.

Both days are free to attend, parking included. The two lunchtime sessions and the Tuesday dinner have their own registration links below.
